Goal: diagnose why the app renders non-English/wrong glyphs after the Inter install. Investigation + safe fix.

State: macOS arm64. App /Users/sachinkoli/github/noteapp/target/debug/bref running (pid ~36028, relaunch if needed) on test vault /tmp/bt (Welcome.md) with HOME=/tmp/fakehome. ~/Library/Fonts now holds ~76 Inter files: 56 Google-Fonts static TTFs (families "Inter 18pt", "Inter 24pt", "Inter 28pt", "Inter 36pt", "Inter Tight"?) PLUS 18 rsms v4.1 OTFs (family "Inter") + 2 variable TTFs. App font chain (src/ui/assets.rs `pick`): prefers family name "Inter", falls back to bundled "IBM Plex Sans"; mono prefers "JetBrains Mono". Branch claude/bref-swap — do NOT switch branches, commit, or push; do NOT run cargo (no rebuilds); repo edits only if the fix is a 1-line font-name correction in src/ui/assets.rs (otherwise report, don't change).

Investigate in order:
1. `cat /tmp/bt/Welcome.md | head -5` and `file /tmp/bt/Welcome.md` — is the file itself intact UTF-8 English?
2. `fc-match "Inter"` and `fc-match "Inter:weight=bold"` — what file does fontconfig resolve? `fc-list | grep -i "inter" | grep -viE "18pt|24pt|28pt|36pt|tight|display" | head` — is plain family "Inter" (rsms OTFs) present and unambiguous?
3. Duplicate-family conflict: both OTF "Inter" and TTF "Inter *" families + variable fonts can confuse CoreText/GPUI resolution (GPUI uses CoreText on macOS, not fontconfig — note which "Inter" CoreText prefers; `ls ~/Library/Fonts | grep -i inter` full list).
4. If a duplicate/variable font is the suspect, fix by REMOVING the conflicting files from ~/Library/Fonts (user-level, safe — they were just installed today; list exactly what you remove) keeping one clean set: prefer the rsms OTF "Inter" family OR the Google static "Inter" TTFs — whichever resolves cleanly — then kill and relaunch the app isolated (HOME=/tmp/fakehome, config first line /tmp/bt) and re-verify with fc-match.
5. Also rule out: file encoding (step 1), and whether the wrong glyphs could be the mono chain (JetBrainsMono Nerd Font has icons — check Welcome.md has no special chars; it doesn't).

Done when: report status; file health; fc-match resolution before/after; files removed (if any); app relaunched pid; whether glyphs should now be correct. Keep it quick.
